function.description: Returns the task details for the given task ID
function.name: api_getTaskDetailsByID

id.description: the `id` of the task to retrieve details for

data.description: Any data associated with this task; the value may vary significantly across different tasks

errorCode.description: An error code if in case this task has failed in its execution

failureReason.description: A textual description indicating the reason why a task has failed

progress.description: A textual representation which indicates the progress of this task; the value may vary significantly across different tasks
